title: Synchronized Inventory
description: This datapack synchronized every player's inventory. Whenever a player obtains or loses an item, everyone also obtains or loses it.
body:
This datapack synchronized every player's inventory. Whenever a player obtains or loses an item, everyone also obtains or loses it.

That's said, if a player died, everyone's inventory will be cleared instantly.

Use `/function si:install` to activate it, and use `/function si:uninstall` to deactivate.

This datapack is inspired by [this video](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/L9B5HDURruQ).
